text.description_html:
Cal-Royal ESC45-30 Passage Function Lever for Panic Device

This Narrow Escutcheon Plate Passage Function Lever (Trim always operable and unlocked. ANSI Function 14) is suitable for all Narrow or Wide Stile Doors (aluminum framed, hollow metal, or wood). For use on door's exterior with Crossbar Narrow Stile Surface Vertical Rod Exit Device. Heavy duty surface vertical rod panic device for narrow stiles.

Packaged with mounting hardware and installation instructions.

Also Available Matching: Entry Lever, Storeroom Lever, and Dummy Trim

Features for CAL-ESC45-30 Passage Function Lever

  • Passage Function (ANSI F14) - Trim always operable and unlocked.
  • Base Material: Steel with Aluminum Alloy Escutcheon Trim
  • Escutcheon Plate Width: 1-13/16"
  • Escutcheon Plate Height: 8-3/4"
  • Total Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Lever Length: 5"
  • Non-Handed
  • Rigid, Non clutch mechanism
  • Grade 1
  • ADA Compliant
  • Installation Instructions (PDF)
